cal.click_edit: Calendar entry tooltip (after the entry title and a hyphen): one click turns the title into an edit box. Hint format.
cal.syntax: Faint line under the calendar day list add box while it is empty: shows the input syntax by example. Keep 14:00, # and the @ repeat word (Korean users type @매주). Separate parts with a middle dot.
cal.day_color: Calendar day list: tooltip of the palette button that shows colour swatches for the open day. Short label.
cal.tag_color: Calendar details panel: tooltip on a tag chip. Clicking the tag shows colour swatches for that tag (shared by every entry with it). Hint format.
cal.mark_none: Calendar colour swatch that removes the colour. Short label.
cal.mark_1: Calendar colour swatch name (screen readers, tooltip). Short.
cal.yearly_lunar: Calendar details panel, Repeat dropdown option: repeats every year on the same Korean lunar date (birthdays, ancestral rites). Short label.
cal.lunar: Lunar date shown in the calendar day list header and day tooltips. {date} is e.g. 9.16 or a leap-month form. Short.
cal.lunar_leap: Leap lunar month marker before the month number {m} (Korean: 윤). Very short.
cal.show_lunar: Calendar widget right-click toggle (a tick shows when on): lunar dates appear in big squares, day tooltips and the day list. Short menu label, no full stop.
cal.every: Calendar details panel: label before a number box and a unit (days/weeks/months/years), e.g. Repeat every [2] weeks. Short label.
cal.unit_daily: Unit after the repeat-interval number box: every N days. Korean reads as N일마다. Short.
cal.unit_weekly: Unit after the repeat-interval number box: every N weeks. Short.
cal.unit_monthly: Unit after the repeat-interval number box: every N months. Short.
cal.unit_yearly: Unit after the repeat-interval number box: every N years. Short.
cal.on_days: Calendar details panel (weekly repeat): label of seven weekday toggle buttons. Short label.
cal.until: Calendar details panel: date box for the last day a repeat happens; empty = never ends. Short label.
cal.prev_week: Calendar header arrow tooltip when the calendar shows rolling weeks. Short.
cal.next_week: Calendar header arrow tooltip when the calendar shows rolling weeks. Short.
cal.rows: Calendar right-click submenu: how much the grid shows (the month, or 1-6 weeks starting this week). Short menu label, no full stop.
cal.rows_month: Item in the rows-shown submenu: the normal month grid. Short.
cal.rows_n: Item in the rows-shown submenu: {n} week rows starting with the current week, scrolling a week at a time. Short.
cal.search: Calendar header search button tooltip and the search box label. Short.
cal.search_ph: Placeholder in the calendar search box: it matches entry titles and tags. Short.
cal.hits: Count beside the calendar search box: how many entries match. Very short.
cal.no_hits: Beside the calendar search box when nothing matches. Very short.
cal.hit_prev: Calendar search: button that jumps back to the previous period with a match; Shift+Enter does the same. Hint.
cal.hit_next: Calendar search: button that jumps to the next period with a match; Enter does the same. Hint.
